_note: Phase 400 (O-01, S1): one provisional job sentence per MCP tool. MCP tools have no frontmatter, so, as for their Phase 399 job labels in data/capability-job-labels.json, the sentences live here. Owner review: 400-LABEL-REVIEW.md.

mcp:artifact_file.when: a piece of work in my room is finished and worth keeping
mcp:artifact_file.want: to file it in the right section with its sources linked
mcp:artifact_file.so: find it later and trace each claim to its source

mcp:chain_resolve.when: I have picked a sequence of thinking methods to run
mcp:chain_resolve.want: to see the exact steps that sequence turns into before anything runs
mcp:chain_resolve.so: check that the plan matches what I meant

mcp:chain_run.when: I have approved a sequence of thinking methods for my room
mcp:chain_run.want: to run the safe steps on their own and stop at the first step that changes my work

mcp:claim_read.when: I need to recall a claim my room already holds
mcp:claim_read.want: to see the claim with its checking record and whether a person confirmed it
mcp:claim_read.so: judge how far I can lean on it

mcp:claim_verify.when: I have checked a claim against a source or a test
mcp:claim_verify.want: to record what I checked it against, the method and the result
mcp:claim_verify.so: show the evidence without pretending the claim is now confirmed

mcp:claim_write.when: a fact, a cause, a rule of thumb or an assumption comes up in my work
mcp:claim_write.want: to record it as a typed claim for review
mcp:claim_write.so: keep it apart from what I confirmed

mcp:context_assemble.when: I open a session in a room I worked in before
mcp:context_assemble.want: to gather the room state, my recent notes and the nearby graph in one place
mcp:context_assemble.so: continue from what the room already knows

mcp:contract_version.when: the assistant I use connects to my local room server
mcp:contract_version.want: to read the version and the trust boundary that the server promises
mcp:contract_version.so: know which calls are safe before I depend on them

mcp:contradiction_check.when: my room has grown and some entries may disagree
mcp:contradiction_check.want: to list the pairs of entries that contradict each other
mcp:contradiction_check.so: settle each conflict before it misleads a decision

mcp:detect_dual_path.when: I open a new conversation with a pasted document or a bare question
mcp:detect_dual_path.want: to tell whether I brought material to file or a problem to explore

mcp:eureka_capability_job_cancel.when: a background analysis I started is no longer useful
mcp:eureka_capability_job_cancel.want: to ask it to stop and then confirm that it stopped
mcp:eureka_capability_job_cancel.so: free the machine and skip a result I will not use

mcp:eureka_capability_job_forget.when: I no longer want the record of a finished analysis kept
mcp:eureka_capability_job_forget.want: to delete that one run after I confirm the request
mcp:eureka_capability_job_forget.so: control what stays stored about my work

mcp:eureka_capability_job_result.when: a background analysis I started has finished
mcp:eureka_capability_job_result.want: to read its checked result, page by page when it is long
mcp:eureka_capability_job_result.so: use the findings while they are still kept

mcp:eureka_capability_job_status.when: a background analysis is running or ran before a restart
mcp:eureka_capability_job_status.want: to see how far it got and whether it ended
mcp:eureka_capability_job_status.so: know when to read the result or start again

mcp:eureka_capability_run.when: I have data in hand and need one local analysis on it
mcp:eureka_capability_run.want: to pick a method from the catalog and run it
mcp:eureka_capability_run.so: get a bounded result that leaves my room unchanged

mcp:eureka_capability_start.when: an analysis will take longer than one reply
mcp:eureka_capability_start.want: to start it as a background job and come back for it later

mcp:eureka_graph_analyze.when: I have picked specific nodes in my room graph
mcp:eureka_graph_analyze.want: to run a local structural analysis on just those nodes
mcp:eureka_graph_analyze.so: spot patterns worth checking without any change to the graph

mcp:eureka_graph_assess_category_edge_pa.when: I suspect some kinds of links in my graph are more common than chance
mcp:eureka_graph_assess_category_edge_pa.want: to compare the category mix of my links with random rewired copies of the graph

mcp:eureka_graph_backtest.when: I am deciding whether to trust a method that suggests new links
mcp:eureka_graph_backtest.want: to test it against the dated links my room already holds
mcp:eureka_graph_backtest.so: see how well it would have predicted what I later found

mcp:eureka_graph_compare_topics.when: I have two groups of notes in my room on related subjects
mcp:eureka_graph_compare_topics.want: to compare the topics of each group in both directions
mcp:eureka_graph_compare_topics.so: see what one group covers that the other misses

mcp:eureka_graph_find_community_bridge_p.when: my graph has clusters that rarely touch each other
mcp:eureka_graph_find_community_bridge_p.want: to find unlinked pairs whose neighbors meet at an important bridge node
mcp:eureka_graph_find_community_bridge_p.so: look for connections across the clusters that I have not made yet

mcp:eureka_graph_find_network_holes.when: I look for gaps in the structure of my graph
mcp:eureka_graph_find_network_holes.want: to find squares of links that miss a diagonal, compared with chance
mcp:eureka_graph_find_network_holes.so: treat each gap as a lead to research

mcp:eureka_graph_find_shared_neighbor_ga.when: two ideas in my graph share many neighbors but have no link
mcp:eureka_graph_find_shared_neighbor_ga.want: to rank those unlinked pairs as candidate links
mcp:eureka_graph_find_shared_neighbor_ga.so: review each one against my sources

mcp:eureka_graph_find_similar_unlinked_i.when: my notes may say the same thing in different places
mcp:eureka_graph_find_similar_unlinked_i.want: to find entries with similar wording but no link between them

mcp:eureka_graph_genesis_plan.when: my room points to questions that cross several fields
mcp:eureka_graph_genesis_plan.want: to turn the selected nodes into a research plan across those fields
mcp:eureka_graph_genesis_plan.so: review the plan before any outside search runs

mcp:eureka_graph_map_neighbourhoods.when: I suspect two parts of my graph have the same shape
mcp:eureka_graph_map_neighbourhoods.want: to compare the neighborhood of a base node with that of a target node
mcp:eureka_graph_map_neighbourhoods.so: carry inferences across as proposals only

mcp:eureka_graph_opportunity_scout.when: I have selected a set of nodes that may hide an opportunity
mcp:eureka_graph_opportunity_scout.want: to screen them for candidate relationship leads
mcp:eureka_graph_opportunity_scout.so: choose which leads to validate first

mcp:eureka_graph_package_relationships.when: I have proposed links between nodes and gathered evidence for them
mcp:eureka_graph_package_relationships.want: to package each link with stable references and its evidence
mcp:eureka_graph_package_relationships.so: hand them to a person for review

mcp:eureka_graph_prepare_artifacts.when: I need my selected nodes in a form that other analysis methods accept
mcp:eureka_graph_prepare_artifacts.want: to convert them into a typed bundle linked to their sources
mcp:eureka_graph_prepare_artifacts.so: run further analysis without losing where each item came from

mcp:eureka_graph_project.when: I need a bounded slice of my room graph for analysis
mcp:eureka_graph_project.want: to read just the nodes I selected from the bound room
mcp:eureka_graph_project.so: work on that slice without exposing the rest of the room

mcp:eureka_graph_propose_relationships.when: I wonder which of my selected nodes should be linked
mcp:eureka_graph_propose_relationships.want: to get candidate links marked as unproven

mcp:eureka_graph_rank_paths.when: I have several candidate chains of reasoning through my graph
mcp:eureka_graph_rank_paths.want: to verify each step against the graph and rank the chains by length and unknowns

mcp:eureka_graph_score_surprise.when: I have prior and later beliefs about some claims in my room
mcp:eureka_graph_score_surprise.want: to score how much each claim moved my belief
mcp:eureka_graph_score_surprise.so: triage which claims deserve attention first

mcp:eureka_hsi_interpret_whitespace.when: an analysis shows empty zones between the topics of my room
mcp:eureka_hsi_interpret_whitespace.want: to read each zone through the problem types and links my graph already holds
mcp:eureka_hsi_interpret_whitespace.so: turn the gaps into questions for review

mcp:extract_shallow.when: I paste a CV, a memo or a pitch at the start
mcp:extract_shallow.want: to pull out who I am and what my venture is without filing anything
mcp:extract_shallow.so: see what was understood before anything is saved

mcp:framework_run.when: I have chosen a thinking method or a sequence of them
mcp:framework_run.want: to get the step plan and halt at any step that would change my work
mcp:framework_run.so: approve each material step before it runs

mcp:gate_answer.when: I have made my choice on a decision card
mcp:gate_answer.want: to record my verdict on that exact card
mcp:gate_answer.so: let only the work I approved go ahead

mcp:gate_list.when: decisions in my room may still wait for me
mcp:gate_list.want: to list the open decision cards and the state of each
mcp:gate_list.so: answer the ones that block my work

mcp:gate_render.when: my work reaches a real choice between options
mcp:gate_render.want: to see the options with their descriptions, ranks and previews on one card
mcp:gate_render.so: choose with the trade-offs in view

mcp:graph_query.when: I focus on one idea in my room
mcp:graph_query.want: to see the nodes and links around it
mcp:graph_query.so: understand its context before I change it

mcp:graph_reason.when: a question about my room needs more than one hop through the graph
mcp:graph_reason.want: to trace support, paths and reach across several links
mcp:graph_reason.so: know whether a claim stands on direct or only indirect support

mcp:graph_write.when: I see that two ideas in my room are related
mcp:graph_write.want: to record a typed link between them
mcp:graph_write.so: make the relation part of what my room knows

mcp:identity_write.when: I state my role, my stage or my way of working
mcp:identity_write.want: to record it once in a place every room reads
mcp:identity_write.so: stop repeating who I am in each room

mcp:memory_event.when: something worth noting happens outside my room
mcp:memory_event.want: to log it as an observation that is never edited later
mcp:memory_event.so: keep an honest timeline of what happened

mcp:question_read.when: I need to recall what my room is trying to answer
mcp:question_read.want: to see the governing question, its origin and every earlier version
mcp:question_read.so: check whether my work still serves it

mcp:question_set.when: the question my room serves is new or has changed
mcp:question_set.want: to record the question with where it came from and why it changed
mcp:question_set.so: keep the history of my thinking honest

mcp:reach_candidates.when: the single next step offered to me does not fit
mcp:reach_candidates.want: to see the full set of candidate next moves for my room
mcp:reach_candidates.so: pick the one that fits my situation

mcp:research_run.when: my room needs outside evidence from scholarly sources
mcp:research_run.want: to plan a quick or deep search and approve each set of queries before it runs
mcp:research_run.so: control what leaves my machine and what gets filed

mcp:room_artifact.when: I need to read one document from my room in full
mcp:room_artifact.want: to open it by its path inside the room
mcp:room_artifact.so: review it without any risk of changing it

mcp:room_bind.when: my session does not yet know which room I am working in
mcp:room_bind.want: to bind it to the right room, or be asked when it is unclear
mcp:room_bind.so: file nothing in the wrong place

mcp:room_changes.when: I keep a view of my room open while work goes on
mcp:room_changes.want: to fetch only what changed since my last look
mcp:room_changes.so: keep the view current without reloading everything

mcp:room_create.when: I have no room yet for a new venture
mcp:room_create.want: to preview its name, purpose and folder before it exists
mcp:room_create.so: approve the room before anything is written

mcp:room_list.when: I open my workspace and have several rooms
mcp:room_list.want: to see the rooms I already have and pick one
mcp:room_list.so: start in the right place without creating a new room by mistake

mcp:room_search.when: I remember a word or phrase from my room but not where it is
mcp:room_search.want: to search the entries, in one section or in all of them

mcp:room_startup.when: I return to a room after a break
mcp:room_startup.want: to get a briefing of where I stopped, what changed and what is still open
mcp:room_startup.so: choose my next move with the full picture

mcp:room_state_bound.when: I need the current state of the room I am in
mcp:room_state_bound.want: to read its state file as it stands
mcp:room_state_bound.so: ground my next step in what the room records

mcp:rs_experts_find.when: I look for people who know a topic in the papers of my room
mcp:rs_experts_find.want: to find authors whose stored papers match that topic
mcp:rs_experts_find.so: know whom to read or contact next

mcp:rs_thesis_read.when: a past discovery in my room may bear on my current work
mcp:rs_thesis_read.want: to read its thesis and details again
mcp:rs_thesis_read.so: build on it instead of starting over

mcp:status_read.when: I wonder where my session stands, spend included
mcp:status_read.want: to see the status segments of my session
mcp:status_read.so: catch a problem or a cost before it grows

mcp:stop_gate_check.when: a session is about to end with a decision still open
mcp:stop_gate_check.want: to be shown the open choice once, and only when it matters
mcp:stop_gate_check.so: close the session without leaving a fork unresolved

mcp:suggest_next.when: I finish a piece of work and am not sure what comes next
mcp:suggest_next.want: to get one suggested next move for my room

mcp:view_compile.when: I need a readable view of my whole room
mcp:view_compile.want: to compile the room into a set of wiki pages
mcp:view_compile.so: browse and share what the room holds

mcp:whitespace_scan.when: I suspect my room has gaps
mcp:whitespace_scan.want: to list the open questions and the claims with no support
